```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', sep=',')

# Aggregate data by year and district
df_agg = df.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'KreisLang'])['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Create combined label for x-axis
df_agg['Year_District'] = df_agg['StichtagDatJahr'].astype(int).astype(str) + ' - ' + df_agg['KreisLang']

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Year_District', y='AnzHunde', data=df_agg, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Number of Dogs per Year and District')
plt.xlabel('Year - District')
